title: Barnaby Badger's Lantern
description: Barnaby makes a bright moss lantern to help a lost beetle find his way home through the dark woods.

scenes.narration: Barnaby Badger lived under a giant oak tree where the ground was carpeted with glowing green forest moss.
scenes.visual: A young badger gathering glowing green moss inside a hollow tree trunk

scenes.narration: As dusk settled over the woods, Barnaby heard a soft crying near a tall fern. A little beetle was lost in the dark shadows.
scenes.visual: A tiny shiny beetle sitting lost on a dark forest path at twilight

scenes.narration: The forest path was too dark for the beetle to see his home. Barnaby carefully placed a glowing patch of moss inside a clear glass jar.
scenes.visual: A badger carefully placing glowing green moss inside a clear glass lantern

scenes.narration: He lifted the lantern high, sending a warm green light dancing across the mossy path and illuminating every safe step.
scenes.visual: A badger holding a softly glowing lantern to illuminate a mossy pathway

scenes.narration: Together, they trotted safely down the trail until the little beetle reached his cozy home under a big red mushroom cap.
scenes.visual: A little beetle reuniting with tiny beetle family members under a mushroom

scenes.narration: Barnaby smiled as the beetle waved thank you. Even a tiny light can make a big difference when shared with a friend.
scenes.visual: A badger watching happy beetles under the warm light of a moss lantern

scenes.narration: May peaceful light guide your dreams tonight. Follow along for more comforting bedtime adventures every evening.
scenes.visual: A cozy forest hollow under a quiet moonlight sky with faint fireflies

character_reference: A small, stocky badger with dense grey fur, a dark snout, and prominent black-and-white stripes running across his face. He wears a simple dark blue vest.
